newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish shares end at record high, forestry up.
newsitem.headline: Swedish shares end at record high, forestry up.

text.p: Swedish shares rose slightly to end at record high levels on Wednesday as a jump in the forestry sector balanced falls in blue-chips telecoms group Ericsson and drugs major Astra.
The general index rose 0.20 percent to a record high of 2,610.23. Trading was heavy with turnover amounting to 5.8 billion crowns.
Ericsson fell two crowns to 246 in the wake of its 1996 result, released a day earlier, but still did not match losses in the share price overnight.
Drug company Astra fell two crowns to 355.5.

"There are three key factors, the dollar, the increased expectations that the market will turn upwards faster than what you previously thought and finally that there is a tendency for investors to turn more to cyclical shares," said Hakan Ostling, forestry analyst at Goldman Sachs.
Stora rose 4.50 to 101.50, while SCA gained four to 160 and MoDo jumped seven to 223.
Metals and mining group Trelleborg rose two crowns to 119.5 crowns after releasing 1996 earnings.
